verdict.rationale: Replit offers scheduled routines as automations [replit-docs-49]. Its Agent task system lets you review work done in isolated project copies before applying it to the main version [replit-docs-39, replit-docs-48]. Publishing creates a stable production version [replit-docs-8]. This gives some review and versioning around the project, but nothing ties versioning or review specifically to routines, and no rollback is documented. Missing for 10: versioning of automations/routines themselves, a rollback or restore-to-previous-version capability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
